summary: The note introduces the Sazerac, a local New Orleans variation of a cognac or whiskey cocktail. It is named after the Sazerac de Forge et Fils cognac brand that was its original main ingredient. The note is truncated and does not describe the full recipe.
one_line: The Sazerac is a New Orleans cognac or whiskey cocktail named after the Sazerac de Forge et Fils cognac brand.
